photos.desc: Two tundra swans rest on the shore of a tundra pond. Photo by Peter Pearsall/USFWS

Tundra swans migrate through the Great Lakes region during the early spring months. The swans stop at public management areas, such as National Wildlife Refuges, as well as some of our larger Partners
